name: taskchef
description: Dispatch work from a data-only workspace to visible Codex project tasks.

interface.shortDescription: Dispatch work to the right Codex project task.
interface.longDescription: Route work to visible Codex project tasks, monitor them in the dashboard, and get concise cached-first coordination briefs.

$taskchef-copilot Explain TaskChef outcomes and recommend the next action.
